description: Waterdieptemetingen is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by fryslan.maps.arcgis.com. Almost all navigable waterways and lakes have been measured at depth by engineering firm MUG. The lakes with raaien every 250 meters, the waterways with a longitudinal turn and transverse turns every 250 meters. The Marrekrite scaffolding has also been measured as well as as as many other scaffolding as possible. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Water depth measurements" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2018-08-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
